content:
Track: Advanced SQL Querying
   - Lesson 1: Joins and Join Types (Inner, Outer, Left, Right)
   - Lesson 2: Subqueries and Nested Queries
   - Lesson 3: Case Statements and Conditional Logic
   - Lesson 4: Aggregate Functions Beyond COUNT and SUM
   - Lesson 5: Window Functions (ROW_NUMBER, RANK, LAG)
   - Lesson 6: Common Table Expressions (CTEs)
   - Lesson 7: Database Design Best Practices
   - Lesson 8: Query Optimization and Performance Tuning

   Track: Python for Data Analysis
   - Lesson 1: Introduction to Python Libraries (NumPy, Pandas)
   - Lesson 2: Data Cleaning and Preprocessing Techniques
   - Lesson 3: Exploratory Data Analysis with Seaborn
   - Lesson 4: Working with Time Series Data using pandas
   - Lesson 5: Merging and Joining DataFrames
   - Lesson 6: Performing Basic Statistical Analysis
   - Lesson 7: Intermediate Data Visualization (Scatterplots, Boxplots)
   - Lesson 8: Introduction to Machine Learning with Scikit-learn

   Track: Excel for Data Professionals
   - Lesson 1: Advanced Formulas and Functions
   - Lesson 2: PivotTables and Slicers
   - Lesson 3: Macros, VBA, and Automation
   - Lesson 4: Power Query (Get & Transform)
   - Lesson 5: Data Modeling with Excel Tables and Relationships
   - Lesson 6: Power Pivot and Calculated Fields
   - Lesson 7: Introduction to Power BI and Dashboard Creation
   - Lesson 8: Connecting and Refreshing Data from Multiple Sources

   Track: Business Intelligence Tools (Power BI, Tableau)
   - Lesson 1: Getting Started with Power BI
   - Lesson 2: Building Custom Visualizations in Power BI
   - Lesson 3: Creating Dashboards and Storytelling with Data
   - Lesson 4: Connecting to Multiple Datasources (SQL Server, Excel, JSON)
   - Lesson 5: Advanced Data Preparation Techniques
   - Lesson 6: Performance Tuning and Data Refresh Strategies
   - Lesson 7: Tableau Basics: Dashboards and Visualizations
   - Lesson 8: Creating Interactive, Mobile-ready Dashboards with Tableau

   Track: Introduction to Machine Learning (Python)
   - Lesson 1: Supervised Learning Algorithms (Regression, Classification)
   - Lesson 2: Unsupervised Learning Algorithms (Clustering, PCA)
   - Lesson 3: Evaluating Model Performance (Cross-Validation, ROC Curve)
   - Lesson 4: Feature Engineering and Selection Techniques
   - Lesson 5: Hyperparameter Tuning and Grid Search
   - Lesson 6: Ensemble Methods and Bagging Algorithms
   - Lesson 7: Real-world Case Studies (Credit Scoring, Churn Prediction)
   - Lesson 8: Model Deployment and Maintenance

   Track: Data Storytelling and Communication
   - Lesson 1: Telling Compelling Stories with Data
   - Lesson 2: Creating Engaging Presentations (Slideshare, Google Slides)
   - Lesson 3: Writing for Data: Reports and Whitepapers
   - Lesson 4: Communicating Insights Effectively through Charts
   - Lesson 5: Best Practices in Data Visualization
   - Lesson 6: Designing Dashboards for Different Audiences
   - Lesson 7: Data Journalism and Newsletters
   - Lesson 8: Building a Data-driven Portfolio
